senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; <cite ref="H00108">preced.</cite> wds.) (with suff. <cite ref="H00076"><he>חֲבֵיר־</he></cite>)
associate, friend, partner (in sacrifices); colleague, fellow-student; fellow-being; of the same kind (also of things).
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:9">Ab. II, 9</cite> <he>ח׳ טוב</he> a true friend; <he>ח׳ רע</he> a false friend. Ib. 10 <he>כבוד חֲבֵרְךָ</he> thy neighbor’s honor.

Sabb. 63ᵃ top בח׳ טוב with a good friend (an obscene disguise for a fair woman, v. גּוּרְדְּלִי); a. v. fr.—ח׳ ותלמיד, (in Babli) תלמיד ח׳ colleague and pupil, a title of distinction for a student, fellow.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:3">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite>; Y. B. Bath. IX, end, 17ᵇ, a. e. <he>ח׳ ות׳ הוה וכ׳</he> was a fellow under R. Ak.; Bab.
<cite ref="Berakhot 27b:3">Ber. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>דתלמיד ח׳ הוה</he> who was a fellow (under Rab).

senses.gloss: Ḥaber, Fellow, a scholar’s title, less than חַכִּים or זָקֵן.
units: Kidd. 33ᵇ (in Chald. phras.) אנא ח׳, אתון חכימי ye are ḥakkime (doctors), and I merely a fellow.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 8b:6">Snh. 8ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ח׳ אינו וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00956"><he>הַתְרָאָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:13">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (play on <he>חֶ֗בְ֗ר֗ו̇ן֗</he>) <he>ח̇ב̇ר̇ הנ̇אה וכ׳</he> that worthy scholar buried &c.

senses.gloss: Ḥaber,member of a religious or charitable association, esp. member of the order for the observance of levitical laws in daily intercourse.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 2:2">Tosef. ib. II, 2</cite> <he>מקבלין אותו להיות ח׳</he> is accepted as a member of the order; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲבֵרִים</he>, <cite ref="H00121"><he>חֲבֵי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:4">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא יכשלו חֲבֵרַי וכ׳</he> that my colleagues (in court) may not fail in a decision of the law.
<cite ref="Berakhot 28b:7">Ib.</cite> <he>הזהרו בכבוד חֲבֵירֵיכֶם</he> take heed of your fellow-students’ honor.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 30b:11">Bekh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בפני שלשה ח׳</he> in the presence of three members of the order.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>חֲבֵרֵיהֶם שלהם עוסקים וכ׳</he> the members of societies among them are engaged in charitable work.
Ib. ואין חביריהם מרגישים and their neighbors (the fruits in the same bag) are not affected; a. v. fr.—Fem. חֲבֵירָה, חֲבֵרָה, חֲבֶרֶת, חֲבֶירֶת.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 8b:6">Snh. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>אשה חבירה</he> a scholarly woman (acquainted with the law).

<cite ref="Berakhot 48b">Ber. 48ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אין מלכות נוגעת בחֲבֶרְתָּהּ וכ׳</he> one term of office does not touch upon its successor even at a hair’s breadth (duration of power is preordained).
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 7">Deut. R. s. 7</cite> <he>אין טיפה מתערבת בחברתה</he> one rain-drop does not mix itself with the other; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="H00118"><he>חֲבֵרוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:4">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>חֲבֵרוֹתֶיהָ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00332"><he>אֲגַף</he></cite>; a. fr.
